_README: This file is managed by LazyCue (see shelley/lazycue). Do NOT edit by hand — it is the cached, machine-generated DSL for a self-healing browser test. To change behavior, edit the test description and re-run LazyCue.
description:
A delayed recording draft does not consume a newer new-conversation composer. The test seeded a conversation {{VIEWED}}. The page fakes the microphone, screen capture and MediaRecorder, and window.__recordingMock counts what the page asked for (read it with eval, e.g. "window.__recordingMock.recorderStarts"): displayRequests (screen captures requested), synchronousDisplayRequests (those requested inside a click or keydown handler), microphoneRequests, audioSources, recorderStarts, recorderStops and stoppedTracks (media tracks stopped). "The recording state" is the data-state attribute of ".recording-status". To "select conversation X from the drawer": if the button with aria-label "Open conversations" is visible, click it; then wait for ".conversation-item[data-conversation-id=\"X\"]" to be visible, click it, and wait until it has the class "active". The recorder "floats" while the recording panel is inside a [data-testid="recording-floating"] element: count '[data-testid="recording-floating"] [data-testid="recording-panel"]' (1 when floating, 0 when not). To "start a new conversation from the header": if the button in ".header" whose accessible name is exactly "New Conversation" is visible, click it; otherwise click the button "More options" and then the button "New Conversation" in ".chat-overflow-popover". Click with click steps, not evals. The server's answer to the browser's first draft creation (POST /api/conversations/draft) is held back until call "releaseOldDraft"; call "oldDraftCreated" says ("true" or "false") whether the server has created it and, once it has, sets {{OLD}} to its conversation ID; call "oldDraftAnswered" says whether the browser has received that answer. The answers to later draft creations are held back for the rest of the test. The message input is [data-testid="message-input"], the voice button [data-testid="voice-button"], the recording panel [data-testid="recording-panel"], and its stop, cancel and retry buttons [data-testid="recording-stop-button"], [data-testid="recording-cancel-button"] and [data-testid="recording-retry-button"]. When a step says an element should contain or have some text, assert that on that element, not with a page-wide wait_text. Perform the steps in order. 
1. Navigate to /new. Fill the message input with "Text owned by the older delayed draft.".
2. Call "oldDraftCreated" until it returns "true". Click the voice button.
3. Exactly one [data-testid="recording-inline"] should exist, and window.__recordingMock.recorderStarts should become 1.
4. Select conversation {{VIEWED}} from the drawer. Start a new conversation from the header. The URL should have exactly the path "/new" (an exact "value", not "text").
5. Fill the message input with "Text entered in the newer new-conversation session.".
6. Call "releaseOldDraft", then call "oldDraftAnswered" until it returns "true".
7. The recording panel should be visible, the recorder should float, the URL should still have exactly the path "/new" (an exact "value", not "text"), and the message input should have the value "Text entered in the newer new-conversation session.".
8. Click [data-testid="recording-return-button"]. The URL should have exactly the path "/c/{{OLD}}" (an exact "value", not "text").
9. Click the cancel button. The message input should have the value "Text owned by the older delayed draft.".
10. Start a new conversation from the header. The URL should have exactly the path "/new" (an exact "value", not "text"), and the message input should have the value "Text entered in the newer new-conversation session.".
